question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**balanced**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is about stress management and adopting healthy coping mechanisms for overall well-being.
 
• The blank (5) comes after the phrase *"prioritising self-care is essential for a ___ and healthy lifestyle"*.
 
• The adjective should logically pair with **"healthy lifestyle"**.
 
• **"Balanced"** is the most appropriate choice because a balanced lifestyle includes proper rest, diet, work, and recreation, ensuring both physical and mental well-being.
 
• Other options like "nutritious," "calming," and "sober" do not fit smoothly in the context of describing an overall lifestyle.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nutritious:** Refers to food rich in nutrients; does not apply to the overall lifestyle in this context.
 
• **Calming:** Means relaxing, but it modifies activities or environments, not lifestyle as a whole.
 
• **Sober:** Means not drunk/serious-minded; it does not fit the sense of a lifestyle description.
